The building rises from a ground floor and two podium levels to nine residential floors and a roof, creating a calm, low-rise setting within an established community. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed with an emphasis on comfort and functionality for couples, professionals and growing families.

Azizi Jewel by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with modern architecture, where glass facades lend the building elegance and landscaped green areas create a comfortable urban setting. Clean lines and a balanced blend of style and functionality give the building a timeless character. It rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments that combine the energy of city life with a calm atmosphere.

Azizi Sakandar by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a modern design that opens up panoramic views of the city. Clean lines, balconies and generous glazing give the building a bright, elegant presence within an established community. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and two podium levels to eleven residential floors and a roof, offering modern studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with retail units at street level.

Azizi Florence by Azizi Developments is a large master-planned community designed as a harmonious blend of nature, architecture and family living. The community is arranged in six clusters, with Lucardo, Bellarno and Soffiano in a contemporary style and Versilia, Pienza and Siena radiating Mediterranean charm. It offers three- and four-bedroom townhouses and four-, five- and six-bedroom villas, each with a maid's room, together with apartments.

Azizi Milan is a contemporary residential development by Azizi Developments, located in the City of Arabia within Dubailand. Inspired by the elegance of Italian design, the project reflects architectural elements reminiscent of Milan’s iconic Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, combining timeless aesthetics with modern urban living. The development offers a range of studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments, all designed with functional layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a focus on natural light, creating a refined and comfortable residential environment suited for both end-users and investors.

Burj Azizi by Azizi Developments is a landmark supertall tower set to become the second tallest building in the world, rising to one hundred and thirty-one floors. Conceived as an architectural marvel that brings together world cultures and sensory experiences, the tower combines hotel apartments on its lower residential levels, private apartments above and penthouses and royal penthouses at the top, all with floor-to-ceiling windows and sweeping views of the skyline and the Arabian Gulf.

Monaco Mansions by Azizi Developments is a collection of ultra-luxury waterfront villas within a large lagoon master community, arranged in eight clusters surrounded by Venetian-style lagoons, green parks and striking architecture. Designs range from royal classicism to contemporary minimalism, with facades oriented towards both the road and the water. The collection offers exclusive six- to eight-bedroom mansions, each spread over four levels connected by a private lift.

Azizi Wasel by Azizi Developments is a luxury waterfront high-rise with a fluid, organic exterior, where several tiers of balconies create a cascading effect. White curved forms are accentuated by subtle integrated lighting, giving the tower an elegant, sculptural look. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to thirteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, three- and four-bedroom penthouses and retail units.

Riviera Rêve is a premium waterfront residential development inspired by the elegance of the French Riviera, offering a refined lifestyle centered around lagoon living. Architecturally, the project is defined by three striking towers designed to reflect the movement of water, incorporating solar panels and vertical greenery to enhance sustainability and air quality. The development features spacious, well-crafted apartments with expansive layouts and panoramic lagoon views, creating a seamless blend of modern design, natural elements, and urban sophistication.

Azizi Ruby by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with elegant glass balconies and a striking golden-toned facade that blends harmoniously with the surrounding greenery. Clean lines and a refined palette give the building a warm, modern presence within a popular family community. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to thirteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with retail units.

Riviera 60 by Azizi Developments is a residential building in a Mediterranean architectural style, distinguished by stained-glass details and elegant facades. Balconies, generous glazing and a warm palette give the building a welcoming, refined character within a waterfront community. It rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with commercial units at street level.

Azizi Emerald by Azizi Developments is a contemporary commercial building where business ambition meets refined design. A distinctive rounded architectural style with flowing golden balconies frames large glass facades, while an elegant upper volume rests on a solid, clean-lined base. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and five podium levels to eleven office floors and a roof, offering innovative office spaces together with retail units at street level.

Azizi Noura by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a refined tiered design, where a slender vertical tower rises above a more substantial base. The facade combines light modern panels with elegant curved accents and generous balconies with glass railings, creating a sense of depth and sophistication. The building rises from a ground floor and three podium levels to eleven residential floors, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with commercial units.

Creek Views 3 by Azizi Developments is a residential tower with an impressive stepped facade, where numerous balconies create a layered, contemporary appearance. A clean white exterior is accentuated by horizontal lines and generous glazing that give the building an elegant, modern look. The tower rises from a ground floor and a three-level podium to nineteen residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level.

Azizi Neila by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building designed for a peaceful yet well-connected urban lifestyle. A modern architectural style with clean lines and light tones gives the building an elegant, welcoming appearance within a calm, established neighbourhood. It rises from a ground floor and two podium levels to nine residential floors, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level.

Azizi Wares by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a refined exterior defined by a grid facade with integrated glass balconies and greenery. Warm metallic accents and clean vertical lines create an elegant, harmonious appearance within the urban landscape. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and three podium levels to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with retail units on the lower levels.

Azizi Arian by Azizi Developments is a modern high-rise residential tower with a striking wave-like facade, where staggered balconies create a dynamic rippling effect that reflects the energy of the surrounding business hub. Smooth white curves, glass balustrades and warm louvres are softened by lush greenery cascading from above. The tower rises above three basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine and five podium levels to seventeen residential floors and a roof.

Azizi Lina by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with elegant facades and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows that create a sense of harmony with the lively urban surroundings. Clean lines and efficient planning give the building a modern, practical character. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and three podium levels to nine residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units.

Azizi David by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower set on the bank of the creek, blending the waterfront heritage of the old city with modern sophistication. A slender tower rises above a wide, light-toned podium, giving the building a balanced silhouette, while an elegant wave-like metal screen defines the base and the tower above shows clean lines and spacious balconies with glass railings. The building rises from a ground floor and a four-level podium to fifteen residential floors and a roof.

Azizi Venice by Azizi Developments is a large-scale waterfront master community that blends Venetian elegance with contemporary design around a crystal lagoon. A collection of mid-rise residential buildings, waterfront villas and mansions is finished with high-quality European materials, sensual design lines and refined detailing. The community offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, villas and premium retail units, with panoramic windows opening onto the lagoon and the lively boulevard.

Azizi Leily by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower that combines a streamlined volume with a wide, light-toned podium, creating a balanced modern aesthetic beside the creek. An elegant wave-like metal screen adds texture at the base, while the clean geometry of the tower is complemented by spacious balconies with glass railings. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to fifteen residential floors and a rooftop with leisure areas.

Azizi Abraham by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower with striking facades and a thoughtful design that combines aesthetics with functionality. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine and three podium levels to sixteen residential floors and a roof. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, together with two- and three-bedroom duplexes and premium retail units at street level.

Azizi Gabriel by Azizi Developments is an elegant residential building with a stepped contemporary facade, where a dark exterior is complemented by numerous balconies with glass railings and striking linear lighting. Lush landscaping frames the structure and emphasises its refined, modern presence. The building rises above four basement levels, lower and upper ground floors and three podium levels to eleven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units.

Aspirz is an innovative mixed-use development by Danube Properties. The project introduces a unique concept that combines luxury residential living with flexible commercial functionality, offering fully furnished convertible hotel apartments from the 17th to the 40th floor. The complex features studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, as well as office space, meeting the needs of diverse residents and businesses. This forward-thinking approach reflects the growing demand for adaptable spaces that support both productivity and comfort within a single property.

Sparklz by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential development located in the vibrant Al Furjan community of Dubai. The 15-storey project offers a selection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed to meet the needs of modern urban lifestyles. Combining sleek architecture with smart home technology and sustainable design principles, Sparklz creates a comfortable and future-oriented living environment.

Timez by Danube Properties is a landmark residential development that combines contemporary architecture with timeless elegance. Characterized by its sleek design and shimmering glass façades, the project creates a striking presence on the skyline while offering a sophisticated urban lifestyle. The development features a collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, including innovative convertible apartments that can adapt to changing lifestyle needs. By blending smart functionality with refined aesthetics, Timez delivers a modern living experience focused on flexibility, comfort, and long-term value.

Oasiz 2 by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential tower located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, offering a modern lifestyle within a dynamic and well-connected district. Rising 31 storeys, the project stands out with its sleek architectural design and thoughtfully planned living spaces, creating a balance between urban convenience and a comfortable atmosphere for everyday life.

Oasiz by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, offering a balanced blend of affordable luxury and modern design. The project is created for those seeking a stylish yet comfortable lifestyle, combining elegant architecture with thoughtfully designed living spaces that promote both relaxation and everyday functionality.

Bayz 102 is a premium residential development by Danube Properties, located in the prestigious Business Bay district. The project offers an extensive selection of residences, including studios, 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, and exclusive penthouses, all designed to combine contemporary luxury with exceptional functionality. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most dynamic urban destinations, Bayz 102 provides residents with breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa and seamless access to the city's key business, leisure, and entertainment hubs.

Diamondz is a luxury residential development by Danube Properties, inspired by the brilliance, rarity, and elegance of a diamond. The project offers a wide selection of residences ranging from contemporary studios to spacious four-bedroom apartments, creating options for different lifestyles and investment goals. Designed with a strong emphasis on sophistication and exclusivity, Diamondz combines modern architecture with premium residential features, establishing itself as a distinctive address within Dubai’s luxury real estate landscape.

Bayz 101 is a landmark residential tower by Danube Properties, strategically positioned in the prestigious Business Bay district. Rising prominently above the surrounding skyline, the development offers panoramic views of some of Dubai’s most recognizable landmarks, including Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Canal, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jumeirah, and the coastline. Designed to provide a sophisticated urban lifestyle, the tower combines contemporary architecture with a prime central location, placing residents within easy reach of the city's major business, leisure, and entertainment destinations.

Sportz by Danube is a modern residential development located in Dubai Sports City, offering a dynamic lifestyle within a vibrant, sports-focused environment. The project combines contemporary living with a strong investment appeal, featuring a pre-launch offer with a guaranteed net ROI of 6% per annum for three years, making it an attractive opportunity for investors seeking stable returns in Dubai’s real estate market.

The Vault by Imtiaz is a boutique commercial building that combines premium office spaces with ground-floor retail units in a compact, highly considered setting. A fully glazed façade, a distinctive bronze-toned form and a refined palette of materials give the building a strong visual presence and a calm, exclusive character. The office floors are planned around flexible, modular configurations, allowing companies of different sizes to shape their workspace around the way they operate.

Solaya is a masterful beachfront creation where innovative architecture beautifully complements the eternal allure of Dubai's shoreline, showcasing a sophisticated design aesthetic that embodies the essence of refined living. The development's nine boutique buildings are meticulously arranged to maximize breathtaking sea and skyline views, creating a stunning visual dialogue between the natural beauty of the surroundings and the elegance of the design, with clean lines, expansive glazing, and fluid indoor-outdoor transitions defining the architectural language.

Palm Springs is a residential community by Nakheel that brings together contemporary villas and townhouses within a nature-led masterplan of green corridors, waterways and landscaped gardens. The Rancho villas offer four- and five-bedroom layouts with expansive living areas and en-suite bedrooms, while the Aliso townhouses provide three- and four-bedroom homes with a more intimate scale and private gardens. Distinctive architecture, elegant proportions and walkable streets give the neighbourhood a relaxed, resort-like character.

projects.n: Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B
projects.ov: Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B is a new benchmark in refined living, where timeless Arabesque sophistication meets the serenity of nature. Surrounded by lush green landscapes and connected to Dubai’s key destinations, the development offers a sense of balance — close to the city yet worlds apart in tranquility. Its contemporary architecture reflects understated grandeur, with soft curves, clean lines, and warm earthy tones inspired by the natural beauty of the hills and horizon.

Lyra, brought to life by Majid Al Futtaim, stands as a nature‑inspired residential tower that crowns the edge of a meticulously landscaped forest. The structure lifts above a ground level and offers a mix of one‑ and two‑bedroom homes, including garden‑type apartments on the lower tier that open onto private outdoor spaces. Its architectural expression embraces the surrounding greenery, framing views of the Ghaf Woods canopy for every resident.

Maserati Island is a branded private island resort community conceived as a curated collection of waterfront homes, where every journey begins with a sea crossing to a dedicated arrival jetty. Low-rise residential buildings with sweeping curved terraces and layered, sculpted balconies wrap around sandy beaches, lagoons and boat moorings, so that most homes look directly onto open water and the city skyline.

Perfectly located in a modern district, VALO emerges as a trailblazing urban jewel, seamlessly blending the serene atmosphere of the waterfront. VALO embodies contemporary sophistication, providing an exclusive blend of luxury, convenience, and distinctive urban charm.

Step into Address Residences Zabeel and embrace a life that is exceptional in every way. In the bustling heart of Dubai's financial district, these four towers stand as landmarks of a refined existence. Here, luxury is the essence of every space, every view and every moment. This is where the city's energy fuses with the calm of upscale living, creating an experience that's as exhilarating as it is serene in the true signature Address style. At Address Residences Zabeel, evenings are gilded with urban brilliance and mornings are bathed in sunrise glory.

Sama Yas by Aldar is a luxury residential community set within a lush park full of flowers, birds and trees, designed to elevate comfort, style and elegance. Its low-rise buildings rise from a ground floor to seven residential floors, with architecture led by Julian Cross of Woods Bagot and interiors shaped by Mustard and Linen. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and garden apartments, with a signature restaurant and kitchen curated by acclaimed chef Izu Ani.

Visualize the dawn breaking over Dubai’s iconic skyline, with the raw essence of urban aesthetics merging seamlessly with the embrace of nature. Aeon epitomizes a bold statement, gracefully intertwining with the waterfront’s soothing ambience and the vibrant beat of Dubai’s heart.

Address Residences Al Marjan Island is a resort-style development by Address Hotels + Resorts in the heart of Al Marjan Island's luxurious lifestyle, located directly by the Arabian Sea and offering guests direct access to stunning beachfront and proximity to the urban hub of the island.

Rosso Bay Residences by Aldar is a branded beachfront community within a five-star resort destination, designed for relaxed coastal living. Three residential buildings, each made up of two connected structures, rise from a ground floor to between twenty-one and twenty-three residential floors. Interiors are styled in warm beige, light grey and wood tones with vibrant red accents. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses, available furnished and unfurnished.

Nikki Beach Residences by Aldar is the first branded residential project in the emirate, created in partnership with the globally celebrated Nikki Beach lifestyle brand. The community comprises three residential towers rising from a ground floor to between eighteen and twenty residential floors, with design and interiors in beige, wood, grey and metallic tones. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, five-bedroom sky terraces and five-bedroom sky villas, available furnished and unfurnished.

Immerse yourself in a world of tranquillity and sophistication within the vibrant community of an exclusive development. Experience the perfect balance of modern elegance and natural beauty as you find your dream home in an oasis of comfort and luxury. Embark on a journey of architectural marvel with three meticulously crafted midrise buildings designed in architectural splendour, captivating the senses with their timeless beauty

Come home to Greenside Residence and bask in the tranquillity of the Dubai Hills Estate’s greenery and open spaces. Add a touch of suburban bliss to your experience of modern urban luxury by taking in the scenic views of the Dubai Hills Golf Course and the surrounding low-rise communities. The sense of arrival at Greenside Residence is unlike any other neighbourhood development. This expansive golf course side haven welcomes all guests to indulge in its facilities, comprising a luxurious lobby with classic contemporary interiors, a stylish residents lounge, and a state-of-the-art elevated podium.

Ethereal waves adorn stylishly crafted façades reflecting the Arabian Gulf ’s rippling waters. A luxury vocabulary inspired by the splendour and glamour of Dubai, translated in the smallest details, inside and out. Exquisite facilities inspired by Address Hotels + Resorts mastery of fine living, tailored to your needs. Bayview by Address Resorts at Emaar Beachfront carries the future in its details and promises a life that will fulfil your dreams of luxurious living by the sea in your luxurious,  
fully- furnished Address Hotels + Resortsbranded home.

Creek Waters 2 rises as a sleek residential tower on Creek Island, presenting a varied collection that spans refined apartments, generous townhouses and a sophisticated penthouse, all anchored by a striking amenities podium. The design emphasizes contemporary urban living, with each unit crafted to meet the expectations of discerning occupants while offering sweeping views of the surrounding skyline. Notable features include expansive rooftop terraces for the townhouses and a high‑end duplex on the uppermost levels that incorporates a dedicated study space.

Marina Shores is a premium waterfront development located in Dubai Marina, offering refined living within one of the city’s most prestigious coastal communities. Rising 52 floors, the tower features elegant residences with unobstructed views of the sea and marina, as well as direct access to the vibrant Promenade, creating a seamless connection between tranquil living and urban energy.

Seapoint by Emaar is an extraordinary collection of landmark towers, showcasing state-of-the-art design and unparalleled luxury. This remarkable development includes a selection of exquisite apartments and penthouses that redefine modern living.

Ocean House by Ellington Properties is a refined residential development set on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, where architecture takes inspiration from the fluidity of the ocean. Comprising a basement, ground level, and nine residential floors, the building is defined by its soft curves and organic lines that echo the movement of water. The project offers an exclusive collection of just 88 residences, including elegantly designed 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplexes, each thoughtfully planned to maximize space, light, and functionality while maintaining a sense of understated luxury.

Samana Waves Phase II is a complex of ultra-high-end residential apartments by the award-winning Samana Developers. Designed for those who prefer leisure, lavishness, and a bit of extravagance in life, this luxurious development offers state-of-the-art apartments with spacious interiors and breathtaking views. Featuring select private pools inside apartments, a leisure deck with a gigantic pool, iconic cascading water features, indoor and outdoor gyms, sauna and steam room, and a dedicated kids' play area, Samana Waves Phase II offers all amenities one could wish for a truly luxurious lifestyle.

Sobha Seahaven by Sobha Group, a brand new residential development offering a choice of luxury design 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments located at Dubai Harbour. These amazing design three towers collection are laced with lower level of surprising lifestyle amenities, where the highest of them comes with 67-storey, rising high in the sky with awe-inspiring views of Dubai.

ORLA by OMNIYAT is an ultra-luxury beachfront development that redefines bespoke living through a seamless blend of architecture, nature, and refined design. Conceived as a private sanctuary, the project offers an exclusive collection of just 86 residences, 3 sky palaces, and 2 mansions, each crafted to deliver a highly personalized living experience. The architecture emphasizes harmony with natural elements, incorporating flowing water features and lush greenery to create a sense of balance, tranquility, and connection with the surroundings.

Elitz by Danube Properties is a landmark twin-tower development located in Jumeirah Village Circle, designed to stand out with its distinctive glass façade and contemporary architectural identity. Positioned in a prime area with direct access to major highways such as Al Khail Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Sheikh Zayed Road, the project offers excellent connectivity across Dubai.

Palm Beach Tower 3 is a masterpiece of contemporary urban architecture, boasting a bold and refined design language that blends effortlessly with the surrounding coastal landscape. As part of the striking Palm Beach Towers development, crafted by the visionary WS Atkins & Partners, this elegant high-rise tower is defined by its sleek, modern form and sophisticated details, integrating residential spaces with vibrant retail and dining areas. The tower's architecture is a perfect blend of modernity and coastal charm, creating a unique and captivating presence that is simply breathtaking.

Samana Downtown One stands as a bold architectural statement that bridges the present cityscape with its future horizon. The building’s striking silhouette, articulated details and strong lines convey a confident, contemporary character that distinguishes it from every angle. Balanced proportions and a refined structural rhythm give each residence a sense of purposeful elegance.

Palm Jebel Ali Villas by Nakheel is an exclusive beachfront residential community where each frond is designed as a private neighbourhood surrounded by lush greenery and pristine beaches. The villas offer a refined coastal lifestyle, with elegant streets, carefully landscaped surroundings, and a strong focus on privacy and tranquillity. Thoughtfully planned open spaces and generous greenery create a peaceful setting where residents can enjoy the beauty of the beachfront environment.

360 Riverside Crescent is a masterpiece of luxury, set amidst a breathtaking development spanning eight million square feet, where serene waterfronts, tranquil lagoons, and lush landscaping converge to create a world of natural splendor. This prestigious tower boasts an exquisite range of one, one-point-five, and two-bedroom apartments, each meticulously crafted to foster a sense of serene well-being, where every detail has been carefully considered to provide a haven of everlasting luxury.

Sobha Central Mall by Sobha Realty rises as an iconic commercial destination, a sleek vertical silhouette capped by a reflective glass façade that commands immediate attention and conveys prestige throughout the Sobha Central community. This exceptional development comprises a ground floor and a first podium level, delivering a thoughtfully curated mix of retail outlets and office spaces designed to meet the most contemporary commercial demands. Every aspect of its architectural composition reflects modern sophistication, creating a distinguished address where businesses can flourish and visitors can enjoy a truly refined environment.

Sobha Estates is an exclusive gated community of villas located within the prestigious Sobha Hartland II, an eight-million-square-foot master development envisioned as an urban community in the heart of a forest sanctuary. Featuring exclusively designed mansions and five and six-bedroom villas, this premium sanctuary is built around weaving natural spaces into everyday living. With over one million square feet of dedicated green area consisting of masterfully landscaped open spaces, tree-lined walkways, and linear parks, Sobha Estates is a residential community that merges nature with your home.

The Woods at Sobha Sanctuary is an exclusive residential enclave set within one of the most coveted plots of the larger Sobha Sanctuary masterplan. Featuring one and two-bedroom residences, this private woodland community is framed by expansive parks at both front and rear, with uninterrupted green vistas and seamless connections to nature. Every window meets the woods, creating homes shaped by water views, natural light, and a deeper connection to the outdoors.

Sobha Solis is a vibrant community that embodies the perfect blend of dynamic energy and serene tranquility, where every moment is an opportunity to ignite your passions and fuel your spirit. This exquisite development spans across four unique towers, each offering a distinct personality while sharing a common podium that is exclusively reserved for residents. The residences at Sobha Solis boast spacious layouts, complemented by expansive windows and balconies that invite an abundance of natural light and breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.

Let the journey begins at Sobha One, a new development by Sobha Group that features 1 to 4-bedroom waterfront apartments located at Sobha Hartland, Dubai. Discover a life that is both rich enough to appeal to the brilliance of modernity and close enough to nature to be considered interesting and elegant.

330 Riverside Crescent is a resplendent waterfront landmark, its tapered crescent design mesmerizing as it catches the reflected hues of the surrounding cluster and dazzles in the reflections of crystal-clear water. This paramount address boasts fifty-seven stories of exceptional craftsmanship, offering a grand new level of luxury that redefines the standards of sophistication. The tower features specially designed one and two-bedroom residences that exhibit all-encompassing views, poised to unveil a soul-stirring experience as residents surrender to the enchanting call of the water.

Sobha Elwood emerges as an extraordinary residential masterpiece that celebrates nature as the greatest inspiration and solace, creating a vibrant tapestry of life on the canvas of nature within a breathtaking community spanning expansive open spaces and lush parks. This visionary development redefines luxury living by seamlessly blending modern design with the four fundamental elements of nature—greens, water, air, and land—to create a sanctuary where every breath is filled with the purest air and every step leads deeper into nature's embrace.

projects.n: Sobha Siniya Island Villas Phases 1 and 2
projects.ov: Sobha Siniya Island Villas Phases 1 and 2 is a masterpiece of luxury and natural harmony, showcasing exquisite villas nestled amidst breathtaking landscapes. The island's unique blend of serenity and vibrancy creates a captivating atmosphere, where the tranquility of untouched natural beauty converges with the dynamic pulse of UAE's cosmopolitan life. This enchanting project features an eighteen-hole golf course, a thriving maritime haven, and a lively boardwalk lined with inviting cafes and restaurants, further enhancing the island's charismatic ambiance.

Yachtside Marina Residences is a masterpiece of luxury waterfront living, nestled on the exquisite Sobha Siniya Island, where pristine white beaches, lush mangroves, and breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf converge to create a truly unique and captivating atmosphere. The project's architecture is a symphony of clean, contemporary lines and organic textures, resulting in a seamless blend of modern sophistication and coastal serenity that redefines the essence of island living.

Pristine Beach Residences represents the essence of contemporary waterfront luxury, where architecture and design come together in perfect harmony. Every detail is crafted to enhance an exclusive lifestyle and provide residents with a sense of ultimate comfort.

Pearlside Marina Residences is a masterpiece of contemporary architecture, where the serene atmosphere of life by the water converges with the finest elements of luxury living, creating a truly unique dimension of sophistication and elegance. Each residence is meticulously designed to be filled with an abundance of natural light, tranquility, and the soothing ambiance of a waterfront lifestyle, perfect for those who crave a peaceful and refined living experience.

Florine Beach Residences, situated on the pristine Sobha Siniya Island, is a masterpiece of coastal luxury and refined living. The development offers an impressive variety of residences, including 1- and 2-bedroom apartments and 2- and 3-bedroom duplexes, designed to cater to diverse lifestyles. Every unit promises breathtaking views of the sparkling beach or the lush, expansive golf course, blending natural beauty with architectural elegance. These thoughtfully designed homes are the epitome of seaside serenity, perfect for those seeking an unmatched blend of relaxation and sophistication.

Canalside Marina Residences by Sobha Realty offers an extraordinary coastal lifestyle on the pristine Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Set along a tranquil canal that flows directly to the Arabian Sea, the development blends modern living with a strong connection to nature. Residents enjoy direct access to a vibrant promenade, lush green parks, and sweeping marina views. This is not just island living — it’s a serene escape shaped by elegance, light, and flow.

Bayfront Marina Residences is a luxury waterfront development located on Sobha Siniya Island, offering a rare fusion of elegance and natural beauty. Surrounded by pristine white beaches, lush mangroves, and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, the project is designed to capture the essence of island living. The architecture reflects clean, contemporary lines softened by organic textures, seamlessly blending modern sophistication with coastal serenity.

The Grove at Sobha Sanctuary is a low-rise villa neighborhood set within the master-planned Sobha Sanctuary community, designed around nature, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. The project features spacious 4–6 bedroom estate villas arranged within a blue-green landscape network, where water, greenery, and walkable environments shape everyday living. The architecture emphasizes refined proportions, privacy, and seamless integration with landscaped surroundings, creating a calm residential enclave that balances scale, exclusivity, and connection to the wider Sobha Sanctuary master plan.

The Brooks at Sobha Sanctuary is a refined residential enclave where nature, wellness, and community come together in perfect balance. Set within the heart of Sobha Sanctuary, the project is designed around the idea of everyday ease — a place where calm landscapes, flowing water elements, and human connection shape a quieter, more intentional way of living. Thoughtfully planned green corridors, shaded walkways, and serene water features create an atmosphere of retreat while remaining part of a vibrant master-planned environment.

The Horizon at Sobha Central stands as a paragon of modern urban living, its sleek design and panoramic skyline views encapsulating elegance and ambition in perfect harmony. This architectural marvel rises gracefully, offering more than just a place to live – it invites residents into a dynamic lifestyle where the city's energy becomes an integral part of everyday life. With layouts that maximize natural light and space, the residences within The Horizon are a masterclass in refined design, complemented by tasteful finishes that blend form and function, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury.

The Tranquil at Sobha Central is a masterpiece of modern urban living, rising majestically along Dubai's iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, where sleek design and panoramic skyline views converge to create an atmosphere of elegance and ambition. This architectural marvel features residences that are a masterclass in refined design, with layouts that maximize natural light and space, complemented by tasteful finishes that blend form and function.

The Eden at Sobha Central is a masterpiece of modern urban living, distinguished by its sleek design and panoramic skyline views that embody elegance and sophistication. This architectural marvel is strategically positioned at the crossroads of business, leisure, and culture, offering residents a dynamic lifestyle that seamlessly integrates the city's energy into everyday life.

projects.n: Bristol Hotel & Residences at Ramhan Island
projects.ov: The Bristol Hotel & Residences by Eagle Hills marks the remarkable reimagining of a legendary name for a new era, bringing together timeless elegance, contemporary living, and the beauty of island life in one exceptional address. This extraordinary development offers just one hundred and twenty-five residences, creating an intimate waterfront sanctuary where privacy meets the privileges of hotel living, with direct marina access, curated amenities, and attentive service blending the comfort of home with the ease of a fully serviced island retreat.

Fashionz is a branded luxury residential development by Danube Properties, located in Jumeirah Village Triangle and positioned among the tallest towers in the community. Inspired by the world of haute couture and developed in collaboration with FashionTV, the project celebrates individuality, style, and contemporary luxury. The architecture and interiors reflect a fashion-forward design philosophy, creating a distinctive residential environment where elegance, comfort, and modern living come together in a unique branded lifestyle concept.

Viewz Residences is a premium residential development by Danube Properties, offering a collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive 4-bedroom sky villas. The project is designed to deliver a sophisticated lifestyle through contemporary architecture, spacious layouts, and exceptional attention to detail. A defining feature of the development is its collaboration with Aston Martin, which has inspired the design of selected interiors, bringing together elegance, craftsmanship, and modern luxury. The residences are thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, functionality, and a sense of exclusivity.

Serro 2 is a contemporary villa community designed to promote living in natural rhythm, where architecture and landscape work together to support balance and wellbeing. The project features modern, sunlit villas with clean lines and warm Mediterranean influences, expressed through white finishes and terracotta accents. The master plan is centered around walkability, greenery, and open spaces, creating a calm residential environment anchored by a central Wellness Centre and Clubhouse. The community offers 3–5 bedroom villas designed with a focus on light, flow, and functional living.

Salva is a thoughtfully planned residential villa community designed around the principles of wellness, balance, and refined living. Set within a serene master-planned environment, the project emphasizes a strong connection to nature, with landscaped surroundings, wellness-focused spaces, and an architectural language that prioritizes light, openness, and calm. Salva is positioned as a peaceful retreat that supports a healthy lifestyle while remaining well connected to key destinations across Dubai.

Serro is a boutique residential villa community designed around the concept of holistic luxury living. The project features Mediterranean-inspired architecture that blends elegant forms with a calm, nature-oriented aesthetic. The master plan emphasizes balance between built spaces and the environment, creating a serene atmosphere through thoughtful layouts, natural elements, and refined architectural details. The community consists of spacious 3–5 bedroom villas, each designed to offer privacy, comfort, and a strong connection to outdoor spaces.

Greencrest by Emaar is a beautifully designed residential project that perfectly reflects modern living with a strong sense of comfort and elegance. The development offers thoughtfully planned 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments, each created to balance functionality, space, and natural light. With Emaar’s proven track record and attention to detail, Greencrest stands out as a refined and highly desirable place to live.

Grove Ridge is a serene residential enclave nestled within the green heart of Emaar South, where contemporary architecture meets the timeless appeal of golf living. Surrounded by open landscapes, rolling fairways, and expansive skies, the project is designed to foster a sense of calm, balance, and belonging. Its architectural language reflects understated elegance, seamlessly integrating modern forms with the natural rhythm of the surrounding environment.

Vista Ridge is a refined residential enclave set within the green heart of Emaar South, where contemporary living is seamlessly integrated with championship golf course surroundings. Framed by rolling fairways and expansive open landscapes, the architecture reflects understated elegance, clean lines, and a strong connection to nature. Designed to embrace light, openness, and scenic views, Vista Ridge offers a tranquil lifestyle shaped by greenery, leisure, and the timeless appeal of golf living.

Avarra by Palace by Emaar introduces a world of refined luxury, where every detail is shaped by the signature elegance of Palace Hotels & Resorts. The project offers an exceptional collection of 1, 2, 3 and 4 bedroom apartments, along with an exclusive 6 bedroom penthouse, all designed as serene personal escapes. Contemporary architecture, expansive glass façades and sweeping balconies frame the sea, the Burj Khalifa and the vibrant skyline, creating an atmosphere of pure sophistication and calm.

Creek Haven by Emaar presents a beautifully crafted waterfront sanctuary where modern elegance meets serene living, offering an inspiring selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments that radiate warmth and refinement. Every home is designed as a private retreat, enriched with soothing water views and soft natural light that elevates daily living. The project embodies Emaar’s signature quality, blending contemporary style with a calm, inviting atmosphere that feels both luxurious and effortless.

Creek Bay by Emaar presents a beautifully crafted waterfront sanctuary where modern elegance meets serene living, offering an inspiring selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments that radiate warmth and refinement. Every home is designed as a private retreat, enriched with soothing water views and soft natural light that elevates daily living. The project embodies Emaar’s signature quality, blending contemporary style with a calm, inviting atmosphere that feels both luxurious and effortless.

Avelia at The Valley presents an elegant architectural expression shaped by the vast desert landscapes, lush meadows, and gentle horizons that characterize this serene master community. The villas feature refined contemporary forms softened by natural tones and organic lines, blending harmoniously with the surrounding greenery. Embracing the natural topography of wadis, mountains, and landscaped trails, Avelia creates a tranquil visual identity where each home feels rooted in nature and part of a calm, picturesque environment.

Ovelle at The Valley presents a refined architectural vision shaped by the serene landscapes of Emirati wadis, mountains, and expansive green meadows. Its villa façades embrace earthy tones, natural materials, and elegant modern lines, creating a harmonious dialogue with the surrounding nature. The community’s masterplan prioritizes slow living, peaceful movement, and organic integration with the land, resulting in a tranquil, nature-inspired environment where open spaces, flowing water, and golden light define the daily atmosphere.

The Row Saadiyat by Aldar is a boutique village of seven sculptural residential buildings conceived by Bjarke Ingels Group, with fluid, organic lines that harmonise with natural light and landscape. Each building rises from a ground floor to nine residential levels, with light facades, panoramic windows and horizontal balconies, while layered lighting creates a sculptural effect in the evening. The collection includes one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts offering a study or a maid's room.

Golf Hills 2 is a contemporary residential development that seamlessly combines elegant architecture with the tranquility of lush green surroundings and panoramic golf course views. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, the project is designed to create a refined living environment where modern design, natural beauty, and everyday comfort exist in perfect harmony. Spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and open-plan interiors fill each home with natural light while creating a seamless connection between indoor living spaces and the surrounding landscape.

Golf Hills is a contemporary residential development that combines elegant architecture with the tranquility of lush green surroundings and panoramic golf course views. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, the project has been thoughtfully designed to create a harmonious living environment where natural beauty and modern sophistication exist in perfect balance. Expansive windows, open-plan layouts, and refined architectural details fill each residence with natural light while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor spaces.

Terra Gardens at Expo City Dubai stands as a sanctuary of modern design interwoven with nature’s calm. Surrounded by lush landscapes and elegant architecture, this community captures the essence of sustainable urban living. Each structure harmonizes sleek, contemporary lines with natural textures, creating an inviting environment where every view opens toward greenery and sunlight.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Lyvia By Palace is a refined residential masterpiece that embodies the spirit of curated luxury. The development offers an exclusive collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments as well as elegant 3-bedroom townhouses, each thoughtfully designed to reflect a balance between sophistication and comfort. Every home features warm neutrals, rich textures, and meticulous details that create a sense of harmony and modern elegance.

Aurea at Rashid Yachts and Marina rises gracefully on the shores of Dubai’s iconic waterfront, where contemporary design meets timeless elegance. Surrounded by sweeping marina vistas, the Dubai skyline, and lush parks, Aurea offers residents an exclusive lifestyle that blends serenity with the vibrancy of a world-class destination. Every detail of its architecture reflects sophistication, from sleek lines and expansive terraces to panoramic glass façades that capture natural light and breathtaking views.

Rise by Athlon is the first apartment collection within an active-living master community by Aldar, designed so that residents are never far from their next activity. Three low-rise buildings rise above a ground floor and a podium to four residential floors, while five themed towers reach between twenty-one and twenty-seven residential floors, creating a dynamic vertical expression of life in motion. Expressive lines, natural materials and lighting accents shape a contemporary silhouette, and the project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Vindera at The Valley is a refined residential community that blends contemporary architecture with expansive green landscapes. Designed with clean lines, elegant façades, and natural surroundings, the development creates a serene environment where flower farms, open meadows, and forest-inspired trails are seamlessly integrated into a modern master plan. The overall concept focuses on calm, balance, and a strong connection to nature, offering a peaceful retreat within a well-planned suburban setting.

Fahid Beach Terraces by Aldar is a beachfront residential collection of six towers designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Flowing forms, extensive glazing and gently curving balconies inspired by tidal imprints mirror the rhythm of the shoreline. Each tower rises above a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors, offering one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room, together with five-bedroom penthouses.

Sera 2 is a thoughtfully designed residential project that combines modern architectural aesthetics with community-focused living. Set within a prime location, it offers residents a harmonious environment where clean lines, contemporary facades, and lush landscaping create a sense of serenity and sophistication.

Selvara 4 embodies the essence of refined equestrian living, where timeless architecture and natural textures create a harmonious balance with its lush surroundings. The community's design draws on clean, contemporary lines, softened by natural elements, resulting in a sophisticated aesthetic that seamlessly blends with the expansive green landscapes and prestigious polo fields. Each residence at Selvara 4 is crafted as a sensory sanctuary, featuring airy spaces that flow effortlessly, with soft natural light illuminating travertine floors, hand-finished woodwork, and veined stone accents.

Selvara 3, a masterpiece by Emaar Properties, presents a curated collection of four-bedroom villas, a masterplan community that embodies the essence of equestrian traditions and refined estate living. The villas, designed as low-density, two-storey contemporary homes, boast clean silhouettes that rise from textured landscapes, their exteriors wrapped in a soothing blend of clay, stone, and soft neutral hues that harmonize with the surrounding landscape. This understated modern contemporary architecture, infused with material warmth, positions Selvara 3 as a sensory sanctuary tailored for intentional living.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Montiva by Vida is a refined residential project nestled within the vibrant Dubai Creek Harbour—a destination where contemporary architecture meets serene waterfront living. Designed with VIDA’s signature aesthetic, Montiva offers a unique lifestyle surrounded by lush gardens, botanical escapes, and panoramic views of the skyline, creek, and parks. The development harmonizes upscale urban design with the calming presence of nature, creating a tranquil retreat in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods.

Baystar by Vida is an elegant waterfront development that brings together the sophistication of Vida Hotels & Resorts with the dynamic spirit of Rashid Yachts & Marina. Featuring a sleek modern façade, the building rises gracefully along the shoreline, offering a lifestyle that seamlessly blends luxury with coastal serenity. Its design reflects a refined minimalism, enriched with soft curves and panoramic glass, capturing the rhythm of the sea and sky.

The Beach House Fahid by Aldar is a coastal residential collection set in the vibrant heart of an island designed around well-being, offering partial views of the expansive sea and the city skyline. The community comprises eleven elegant buildings, five rising from a ground floor to seven residential floors and the others to nine residential floors, where contemporary architecture blends with the natural surroundings. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room.

Rosehill offers a serene collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to harmonize with nature and elevate everyday living. Each home is bathed in natural light, framed by lush gardens and panoramic vistas of the Dubai Hills Golf Course. With open-air terraces and soft landscaping, the residences embrace a calming connection between indoor elegance and outdoor tranquility.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Discover Silva, a canvas painted with nature’s finest hues and the city’s vibrant strokes. Here, the cadence of Creek views, skyline view and jade landscapes create an inspiring backdrop for a life of poised living. From green living, calm waterside paths to dynamic retail havens, experience a curated blend of peace and vitality.

Vida Residences Hillside is a stunning project offering a selection of exquisitely designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 3-bedroom townhouses. Each home features a private balcony that opens up to captivating views of Dubai Hillside Park, blending modern urban living with lush natural beauty. The architecture and interior design reflect a serene minimalism, using earthy tones and clean lines to create a calming atmosphere.

Beach Residences at Siniya Island is a premium waterfront project by Sobha Realty, featuring four luxurious residential complexes: Aquamarine, Delphine, Selene, and Coraline. The development consists of a total of four towers, including two 7-story Towers A and C, one 9-story Tower B, and one intimate 2-story Tower D. Located on the scenic Siniyah Island in Umm Al Quwain, the project offers tranquil coastal living, where modern architectural aesthetics blend harmoniously with the island’s natural beauty. The residences across all three complexes boast elegant interiors and contemporary designs, providing a luxurious and serene lifestyle.

Reportage Village Khalifa City is a masterpiece infused with a contemporary Italian touch. Featuring a collection of thoughtfully designed townhouses, this development strives to create a luxurious lifestyle in the beautiful capital. Surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and community retail outlets, the project creates a vibrant and convenient neighborhood where residents can open up to life and breathe the luxury of living among lush greens.

Topaz Residences is a prestigious development by Eagle Hills. This thirteen-storey building features a curated collection of one to four-bedroom apartments and luxury three to four-bedroom townhouses, housed within a ground floor, a two-level podium, and residential floors. The design draws inspiration from the region's traditional architecture, reimagined through a contemporary lens, with a clean, minimalist façade and a timeless palette of beige and brown tones that seamlessly combines distinguished conventional architectural practices with modern amenities.

Skyscape at Sobha Hartland II emerges as the definitive pinnacle of luxury waterfront living, a breathtaking eighty-five-story tower that elevates the very concept of sophisticated urban existence to extraordinary new heights. This remarkable residence stands as a testament to Sobha Realty's legendary craftsmanship, where exceptional attention to detail, from conceptualization to completion, reflects an unwavering commitment to timeless quality and perfection.

Sobha Realty has redefined the concept of luxury residential living with the exquisite Sobha Orbis, a masterpiece that embodies the Art of Detail philosophy, where meticulous attention to detail crafts luxury living experiences that surpass the ordinary. Nestled in the dynamic cityscape, Sobha Orbis emerges as an emblem of refined living, boasting sleek architectural design and sumptuous interior finishes that evoke a timeless aura of luxury. This premium three-tower luxury apartment complex stands as a jewel in the crown of the vibrant new community, with every detail curated to indulge the senses and elevate the living experience.

Marlin is an interesting interplay between the simplicity of modernity and the grandeur of blue vistas, offering a lifestyle that goes far beyond the ordinary. The development comprises two striking towers designed with sweeping curved balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light and reflections of blue into every home. The collection features a refined mix of one, two, three and four-bedroom apartments, along with exclusive three and four-bedroom penthouses, each designed according to the highest standards with stunning elegance that appeals to the finest of tastes.

projects.n: The Woods Abode at Sobha Sanctuary
projects.ov: The Woods Abode at Sobha Sanctuary is an exclusive residential enclave set within one of the most coveted plots of the larger Sobha Sanctuary masterplan. The development comprises exclusive one- and two-bedroom apartments arranged across its upper residential floors. Homes are designed around park views, natural light, and a deeper connection to the outdoors. The collection, branded as The Harmony Compendium, brings together calming views and refined spaces within a single, thoughtfully designed address.

The Greens at Sobha Sanctuary emerges as a truly exceptional villa community crafted for residents seeking balance, privacy, and restorative living within one of the most visionary master-planned destinations. This remarkable collection offers four-bedroom Garden Villas and five-bedroom Courtyard Villas, thoughtfully designed with smart-home readiness and generous outdoor spaces that invite residents to embrace a lifestyle of calm and connection.

The Willows at Sobha Sanctuary is a gracefully planned villa enclave shaped by flowing greens, soft landscapes and a sense of quiet continuity, designed for residents who value calm, connection and a slower, more intentional way of living. The enclave offers four-bedroom Garden Villas in several layouts, including corner and middle homes, all smart-home ready and arranged along landscaped streets with private gardens.

projects.n: The Woods Horizon at Sobha Sanctuary
projects.ov: The Woods Horizon at Sobha Sanctuary is a private residential building created around park views, natural light, and a deeper connection to the outdoors. The development comprises exclusive one- and two-bedroom apartments arranged across its residential floors, with parks framing the building at the front and rear. Every home opens onto its own balcony, giving the collection a calm, woodland character and a sense of openness.

Binghatti Skyrise by Binghatti is a landmark residential development of three high-rise towers with a crystal-like facade that catches the light like a rare gemstone. Crafted with exceptional attention to detail, the towers rise above basement and podium parking levels to more than forty residential floors, creating an iconic presence on the skyline. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed for refined everyday comfort.

Tilal Binghatti is presented as a thoughtfully designed masterplanned villa community that reimagines the developer’s signature architectural style on the ground, creating a calm and complete living environment. The project focuses on spacious, family-oriented living, offering elegant 4, 5, 6 and 7-bedroom villas within a private gated setting designed for long-term comfort and stability. It is positioned as “a life meant to feel steady, open, and complete,” emphasizing balance, greenery, and a sense of everyday ease.

Shahrukhz by Danube is a landmark premium office development, created as a statement address for business leaders, founders, and visionaries. Inspired by the self-made journey of Shahrukh Khan, the project celebrates ambition, success, and the pursuit of building a lasting legacy. Its striking architecture and prestigious location provide exceptional visibility, while a thoughtfully designed business environment creates a distinctive setting for companies looking to establish themselves at a prominent Dubai address.

Greenz by Danube is an exclusive residential development offering a limited collection of fully furnished premium townhouses and villas designed with modern architecture and elegant Italian-style interiors. The development features a range of townhouses, semi-detached and twin villas available in 3, 4, and 5-bedroom configurations. Each home is designed with generous layouts, including maid’s rooms, expansive living spaces, and private rooftop gardens that enhance both functionality and luxury living.

Serenz by Danube is a striking 50-storey residential development located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. Conceptualized as «A World of Amenities», the project sets a new benchmark for modern urban living by seamlessly blending luxury, comfort, and functionality within a vibrant community setting. Serenz by Danube represents a new standard of residential living in JVC—where thoughtful design, world-class amenities, and prime connectivity come together to create a truly elevated lifestyle.

Cove Boulevard by Imtiaz Developments is a residential tower. The project embodies modern elegance with its sleek white façade, curved architectural elements, and distinctive protruding balconies. Designed to offer a sophisticated yet comfortable living experience, the tower features fully furnished studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, with select units boasting private pools on their balconies — an exclusive touch of luxury with breathtaking views of the cityscape.

Wynwood Horizon by Imtiaz is a contemporary residential development offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom penthouses. The project is designed with a focus on space, natural light, and refined modern living, featuring thoughtfully planned layouts and elegant interiors that create a comfortable residential environment. Large windows, spacious living areas, and carefully considered design elements enhance the sense of openness throughout the residences, while the overall architectural concept combines contemporary aesthetics with functionality and everyday comfort.

Wynwood by Imtiaz is a contemporary luxury residential development designed to combine striking architecture with sophisticated urban living. The project offers a collection of residences ranging from one-bedroom apartments to spacious duplexes, all conceived with an emphasis on space, natural light, and refined design. Floor-to-ceiling windows, expansive terraces, and carefully crafted interiors create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living areas.

Kore by Imtiaz is an inspiring residential project that draws its name from the body's centre of strength and stability, and it is designed entirely around human performance, longevity and healthy living. Far more than a residence with a gym, it brings together personalised training, intelligent fitness technology, nutrition-focused living and advanced recovery experiences, helping residents live with greater energy, balance and focus every day. The collection offers beautifully planned studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, each created to support a truly holistic wellness lifestyle.

The Archive is a residential masterpiece that redefines the concept of home, masterfully blending architectural brilliance with a deep appreciation for literature and learning. At its heart lies a meticulously curated collection of ten thousand real books, creating an unparalleled living experience that invigorates the mind and nourishes the soul. Every space within this visionary development has been thoughtfully conceived to honour the art of reading and the beauty of contemplation, from the majestic two-storey library wrapped by a graceful spiral stair to the serene writer's room that inspires creativity.

Raw District Phase 2 by Imtiaz Development is an exceptional residential project that brings together contemporary design, comfort, and a vibrant lifestyle in one outstanding destination. The development offers a collection of beautifully designed studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments, giving residents a wide range of stylish homes that suit different lifestyles and needs.

Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an “urban lifestyle philosophy” rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Its architecture embraces a raw, minimalistic aesthetic with open, adaptable spaces that prioritize functionality, movement, and continuous evolution.The project offers a wide range of fully furnished residences, including studios, 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, alongside office and retail spaces.

Sea Cliff by Imtiaz is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor–outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views.

Elitz 3 by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential tower located in Jumeirah Village Circle, designed to redefine modern urban living through its distinctive architecture and premium positioning. Featuring a striking glass façade, the development stands out as a symbol of sophistication within one of Dubai’s most востребованных residential communities.

Nine Collective is an ultra-luxury residential development that brings together cosmopolitan living, contemporary architecture, and refined design in a location where the city’s heritage meets its modern identity. Its sculptural tower is defined by distinctive geometric forms, stone-inspired finishes, and a thoughtful balance of solid volumes and expansive glazing. With views towards the Downtown Dubai skyline and a lush central plaza, Nine Collective offers an elegant urban setting with a strong sense of space, privacy, and exclusivity.

Avenue Park Towers 2 by Wasl presents the concluding offering within a celebrated freehold enclave, delivering a balanced collection of one, two and three‑bedroom apartments alongside three and four‑bedroom duplexes that include thoughtful maid’s quarters. The towers showcase a sleek glazed façade that invites abundant daylight, while the layout emphasises openness and a minimalist aesthetic that enhances spatial quality for an urban residence with lasting appeal. Each dwelling benefits from generous floor plans and extended terraces that frame unobstructed views of the surrounding skyline.

Cedarwood Estates South by Wasl is an exceptional collection of 74 thoughtfully designed villas, created around a refined vision of space, nature and modern family living, with every home positioned along sweeping golf views. The project offers elegant 4, 5 and 6 bedroom villas, each combining generous proportions, sophisticated architecture and a strong connection to the surrounding landscape.

Pinewood Estate Homes, a masterful creation within The Next Chapters, redefines the essence of refined residential living, setting a new benchmark for elegance and serenity in the heart of Dubai. This exquisite project presents a harmonious blend of thoughtful architecture, meticulous attention to detail, and a seamless integration with the surrounding natural landscape, yielding a tranquil and private ambiance that envelops each of the beautifully crafted three- and four-bedroom homes.

Avenue Park Towers, a prestigious residential development by a renowned developer, epitomizes the perfect fusion of urban sophistication and natural serenity, boasting breathtaking views of Zabeel Park and the iconic Dubai Frame. This exceptional mixed-use community presents a serene living environment with lush green spaces and a vibrant atmosphere, where residents can immerse themselves in tranquil surroundings while enjoying modern amenities and lifestyle conveniences. The development's thoughtfully designed interiors exude elegance and functionality, with spacious layouts and refined design elements that enhance the living experience.

Hillside Residences, a breathtakingly beautiful development, boasts an exquisite blend of urban sophistication and lush greenery, creating a serene oasis in the heart of Dubai. This exceptional freehold development is meticulously designed to provide residents with an unparalleled living experience, replete with every conceivable amenity, from sprawling terraces and barbecue areas to well-designed walkways, multiple state-of-the-art gyms, and sparkling swimming pools.

Boulevard Park at Wasl Gate is a visionary residential community, distinguished by its sleek architectural lines, modern volumes, and cohesive urban aesthetic that harmoniously blends mid- and high-rise towers. The masterfully designed ensemble of buildings creates a visually stunning skyline, while generously sized balconies, glass balustrades, and double-glazed façades ensure an abundance of natural light and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living spaces. This contemporary community prioritizes comfort, accessibility, and an elevated residential environment, meticulously crafted to deliver long-term value.

Tranquil Beach Residences at Sobha Siniya Island is a refined waterfront residential development designed to embrace the serenity of island living. Set within the natural surroundings of Sobha Siniya Island, the project is envisioned as a coastal sanctuary where architecture and nature exist in harmony. The residences are positioned to capture panoramic views of the natural beach, lagoon waters, and the expansive Arabian Sea, creating a peaceful environment where the rhythm of everyday life is shaped by sea breezes, open horizons, and the calming presence of water.

Jumeirah Asora Bay is an exceptional coastal development set along the shores of Dubai, redefining luxury living through a seamless blend of architecture and nature. The project presents an exclusive collection of expansive residences, from four- to six-bedroom apartments and duplexes to ultra-luxury penthouses and mansions. Designed to harmonize with the surrounding landscape, the architecture is defined by flowing forms, panoramic glazing, and generous terraces that open to uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf, creating a refined balance between elegance and natural beauty.

Pierside Marina Residences is a premium waterfront development by Sobha Realty. Situated on the scenic Siniyah Island in Umm Al Quwain, the project offers a serene coastal living experience where modern architectural aesthetics seamlessly blend with the natural beauty of the island. The residences in all three complexes feature elegant interiors and contemporary designs, providing a harmonious and luxurious lifestyle.

Marlin 2 is an architectural masterpiece by Reportage Group, one of the largest private developers in the UAE. Inspired by the rhythm of the waves, this stunning residential tower flows with the elegance of the ocean and the dance of sunlight, standing as a tribute to fluidity, movement, and timeless design. Offering an exclusive collection of two, three, and four-bedroom apartments, the development redefines luxury living with a seamless blend of nature's artistry and human innovation. More than just a structure, it is an experience—crafted for those who see beyond the horizon.

Coastline Beach Residences, situated on the pristine Sobha Siniya Island, is a masterpiece of coastal luxury and refined living. The development offers an impressive variety of residences, including 1- and 2-bedroom apartments and 2- and 3-bedroom duplexes, designed to cater to diverse lifestyles. Every unit promises breathtaking views of the sparkling beach or the lush, expansive golf course, blending natural beauty with architectural elegance. These thoughtfully designed homes are the epitome of seaside serenity, perfect for those seeking an unmatched blend of relaxation and sophistication.

The Element at Sobha One is a true masterpiece of modern elegance, seamlessly blending luxury with nature’s serenity. Designed to redefine urban living, this architectural marvel offers an exceptional collection of 1 to 4-bedroom residences, each thoughtfully crafted to provide unparalleled comfort and sophistication. Expansive open spaces and breathtaking panoramic views create an atmosphere of tranquility, where natural light and sweeping vistas immerse residents in a world of refined beauty.

Bayside Marina Residences is a premium waterfront development that seamlessly blends contemporary architectural elegance with luxurious living. The project offers a selection of meticulously designed residences featuring expansive layouts, high-quality finishes, and breathtaking views of the marina and the surrounding seascape. Every detail has been carefully curated to provide a harmonious balance of comfort, functionality, and style, catering to the discerning tastes of modern homeowners.

Skyvue Solair, the inaugural tower in the esteemed Skyvue cluster, presents a rare opportunity to experience limitless possibilities in a unique and sophisticated living environment. This distinguished residence boasts an exceptional collection of amenities, seamlessly connected to create an unparalleled living experience. With a rhythmically flowing zigzag facade set within a triangular floor plan, Skyvue Solair's masterful design invites panoramic views into every space, crafting an effortlessly elevated living experience.

The Alba Residences by OMNIYAT is an ultra-luxury residential sanctuary designed to embody tranquility, elegance, and refined coastal living. Conceptualized as a private retreat, the project seamlessly blends natural surroundings with sophisticated architecture by Zaha Hadid Architects, creating a harmonious environment where light, space, and nature come together. Positioned within the iconic Palm Jumeirah, it offers an exclusive lifestyle centered on wellness, privacy, and understated luxury.

Olfah by Alef is a walkable residential community designed around a forest-inspired landscape, blending nature with urban living. The masterplan brings together a collection of residential buildings of varying heights, each with a ground floor and generous residential levels. Contemporary architecture focused on simplicity and functionality features large windows and open facades that bring in daylight and fresh air and frame panoramic views. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with larger homes including a maid's room.

The Pinnacle at Sobha Central is a masterpiece of refined urban living, conceived as the tallest residential tower in the development, where the interplay of height, light, and perspective creates a truly distinctive everyday experience. Its commanding position above the city affords a sense of calm authority, framing expansive skyline views that define the residential environment with clarity, balance, and understated elegance. The Pinnacle's thoughtfully designed residences support a sophisticated residential rhythm, perfectly balancing dynamic city living with moments of retreat.

The Orchard at Sobha City is an exclusive collection of private villas designed to offer a refined balance between nature, space, and contemporary living. Set within a masterfully planned waterfront community, the project features elegant 4, 5, and 6-bedroom estate villas, each thoughtfully positioned amidst lush greenery and tranquil surroundings. The Orchard stands out for its intimate scale and cohesive vision, where tree-lined streets, landscaped pockets, and seamless connectivity create a neighborhood with a distinct identity and long-term livability.

The Terraces at Sobha City is a thoughtfully master-planned residential development defined by contemporary architecture, open spatial planning, and a strong connection to nature. The project features a collection of garden villas designed with an emphasis on natural light, privacy, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Residences are positioned to maximize views of landscaped greenery and water features, while private gardens and elevated terraces extend the living experience beyond interior spaces. The overall design integrates green corridors, shaded walkways, and water elements, creating a calm and balanced urban environment.

Brabus Island is a distinctive waterfront development set in the prestigious Al Seef District, redefining luxury living through bold, automotive-inspired architecture. Designed in collaboration with BRABUS, the project features sculptural forms, dynamic lines, and a striking contemporary aesthetic that echoes the precision and power of high-performance design. Positioned along a serene turquoise coastline, the development combines dramatic visual identity with open, light-filled residences, where expansive glazing and flowing layouts create a seamless connection between indoor spaces and the surrounding waterfront.

The WADI is a waterfront residential development located within the Yas Canal community in Abu Dhabi, designed as a destination where nature, architecture, and everyday living seamlessly intersect. Set next to Yas Island, the project is shaped by flowing canals and landscaped surroundings, creating a tranquil yet vibrant environment inspired by the rhythm of water.

Oceana is a sanctuary by the sea — a retreat that seamlessly blends nature's rhythm with modern elegance, nestled on the tranquil shoreline. The architectural design mirrors the horizon, allowing the beauty of the ocean to flow effortlessly into every space.
