With its fluid lines, open layouts, and resort-inspired atmosphere, Oceana embodies serenity and sophistication, creating a sense of calm that transcends the everyday.

Sila represents a thoughtful vision of modern residential living shaped by sustainability, design excellence, and a deep connection to nature. Conceived as a contemporary residential community, the project blends architecture and landscape to create homes that feel calm, refined, and closely aligned with the environment. The villas and townhouses are designed as elegant family residences, offering spacious layouts, natural light, and an atmosphere that celebrates both privacy and community living.

Reportage Tower is a high-rise residential development, which offers contemporary high-end apartments with views of the canal. Its modern sustainable facade creates a distinctive architectural presence in the centre of the island, which is recognized as one of Abu Dhabi’s prominent luxury destinations. The development comprises 280 residential units and 12 commercial retail spaces, providing a combination of residential and commercial offerings within the project.

Selina Bay, a residential complex by Reportage Properties, consists of two multi-storey buildings, West and East, each with basement, ground, and 18 residential levels. The project features modern architecture and landscaped grounds. Residence formats include studios, 1-3 bedroom apartments, and duplex penthouses with 3-4 bedrooms, as well as 4-bedroom townhouses.

Baia by Reportage Properties is a refined residential community inspired by the natural rhythm of waterfront living, where architecture and lifestyle flow in perfect harmony. This exclusive development offers elegant 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses, thoughtfully designed to combine privacy, space, and a strong sense of connection. With its intimate scale and carefully crafted layout, Baia creates a peaceful yet sophisticated environment where every moment feels meaningful and elevated.

Sensi is a refined residential sanctuary located on Saadiyat Island, where culture, nature, and understated elegance converge. Conceived as more than a place to live, the project is shaped by a philosophy of balance, clarity, and emotional connection to space. Minimalist architecture, light-filled volumes, and carefully composed proportions create an environment where design does not dominate, but gently supports a slower, more meaningful way of life inspired by art, light, and the surrounding landscape.

The District is a thoughtfully designed, fully integrated community located on the serene Al Reem Island in Abu Dhabi. It embraces a modern, vertical living concept where everything is just steps away—offices, medical centers, shopping outlets, fitness hubs, and more. This development is tailored for those who seek a lifestyle of convenience, where the boundaries between work, wellness, and leisure naturally blur.

Perla 1 at the Bay is a brimming gem at the bay, a signature Italian-designed development. Being the first building in Abu Dhabi with only one elevation, all units have direct sea views embracing the shades of blue. Designed to meet all refined tastes, this high-rise building features duplex apartments and three-story townhouses, each with an equal share of sunshine and sea views, making every moment an exciting experience to look forward to. From high-quality finishing and modern facades to perfectly designed spaces and interior art, every bit of space is well-thought to reflect the very essence of magical Yas Island.

Vista 3 is a masterpiece of modernity and aesthetics, standing as a super high-rise building right at the waterfront in one of most sought-after destinations. Following Abu Dhabi's futuristic approach, this stunning residential tower provides the whole lifestyle of Al Reem Island with its luxury, modernity, and accessible fun for all. Offering a wide range of unit types from one to five-bedroom apartments, Vista 3 embraces the colourful horizon of Al Reem Island, where every day is your best day.

Verdana VI is a premier residential community, offering a contemporary and luxurious lifestyle in close proximity to Dubai's major attractions. Surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and retail outlets, this thoughtfully designed development provides a serene and well-connected living environment. Featuring a mix of townhouses and apartments, each residence is crafted to the highest international standards in design, quality, and space, creating homes that are both elegant and functional.

Verdana IV, crafted by Reportage, stands as a contemporary residential enclave offering studios and apartments ranging from one to three bedrooms alongside townhouses configured with two to four bedrooms. The development comprises a multi‑storey block rising nine residential levels and a separate tower ascending fifteen residential levels, both anchored by basement tiers and podium decks. Architectural intent focuses on sleek silhouettes and generous floor plates that nurture airy living spaces.

Verdana III is a premier residential community, complementing the green picture of luxury and privacy with a collection of townhouses and apartments built to the highest international standards. Step into a world where modern elegance meets nature's touch, and art freely expresses itself. This integrated community offers exceptional facilities and a location in the heart of the city, yet away from the hustle, ensuring a serene and fulfilling life where every day can be fully embraced.

Alba Tower by Reportage Properties is an exclusive residential mid-rise tower bringing the whole city's luxury to your doorstep. With its meticulous Italian design and captivating interiors, this development offers an extraordinary living experience and a seamless blend of style and convenience. Featuring a collection of one and two-bedroom apartments, Alba Tower redefines urban living, providing a haven of comfort, sophistication, and tranquillity in the heart of the city.

Taormina Village is an extraordinary residential community that redefines luxury living with its exquisite selection of townhouses and villas. Offering a range of three, four, and five-bedroom residences, this development combines elegance with functionality, ensuring spacious and beautifully designed homes for every lifestyle. The pristine white facades and lush green surroundings create a harmonious balance between modern architecture and nature, with every detail thoughtfully crafted to deliver a refined and sophisticated living experience unlike any other.

Reportage Hills is the first of Reportage Properties' upscale signature line, a contemporary gated townhouse community tailored to redefine high-end living. This exclusive community offers a collection of three, four, and five-bedroom townhouses with timeless designs and world-class amenities. With sleek architecture that sings in shades of blues, evoking a rhythm of calm elegance and soulful sophistication, Reportage Hills stands out as an icon of timeless beauty.

Ivy Gardens 2 by Samana Developers is an architectural marvel that redefines luxury. This symphony of contemporary design and timeless elegance stands as a beacon of prestige, where every facet of existence is concealed in lavish sophistication. Featuring studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments with private pools, this development is meticulously crafted to cater to the most discerning tastes, offering a tapestry of opulence that is simply awe-inspiring.

Samana Mykonos Signature is the epitome of luxury living in Dubai, building on the phenomenal success of its predecessor to take refined living to new heights. This exclusive residential property features a collection of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, all designed to exceed even the loftiest of expectations. From its striking, minimalist yet stunning architecture to its vibrant hues, every detail has been carefully crafted to transport residents to the sun-kissed shores of the Greek island of Mykonos, creating the perfect retreat from the stresses of everyday life.

Samana South Haven 2 emerges as a truly exceptional residential address, a stunning architectural statement that brings a new direction to call home in one of the city's most dynamic and rapidly growing districts. This remarkable development offers a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences, thoughtfully designed to deliver a lifestyle of balance, refinement, and modern comfort.

Samana Business Hub emerges as a landmark commercial and lifestyle destination, born from movement, trade, and ambition, and designed to amplify the energy of a district that drives global commerce and connects continents. This exceptional development by Samana is built to reflect the vital role in Dubai's economy, offering world-class infrastructure alongside thoughtfully curated experiences that make business excellence and lifestyle elevation inseparable. With its strategic positioning within Dubai's economic core, this is a place where businesses that drive the economy forward find their perfect home.

Samana Barari Avenue is a premium commercial development by Samana Developers, conceived as a business park reimagined for success in the heart of Majan. Blending cutting-edge architecture with high-end office spaces and prime retail outlets, it is a landmark destination where visionaries, entrepreneurs and established enterprises come together to reshape the future of business. Strategically positioned along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, the project sits within easy reach of Dunecrest American School, Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport.

Royal Park - The Majesty of Living is a residential community developed by Reportage Properties consisting of 6 buildings. The community includes apartments with 1-4 bedrooms, three-storey townhouses, and duplex penthouses. The architectural design blends timeless elegance with modern elements. Residents can expect panoramic city views from their residences.

Vela Viento by Omniyat is a landmark residential development that redefines contemporary luxury living in Dubai. Designed by the globally renowned Foster + Partners, the tower is characterized by fluid horizontal lines and elegant curves that create a dynamic architectural rhythm. Interiors are crafted by the Parisian design studio Gilles & Boissier, bringing a refined balance of modern sophistication and timeless elegance. The project features an exclusive collection of two- to four-bedroom residences and signature penthouses, many with double-height spaces and private terrace pools, emphasizing seamless indoor-outdoor living.

310 Riverside Crescent is a residential masterpiece that redefines luxury living, nestled within a stunning eight million square feet development, adorned with a breathtaking beach and blue lagoon, expansive open spaces, and lush landscapes. The residences are draped around the beautiful lagoons, offering a serene and tranquil atmosphere, where nature and luxury blend in perfect harmony. Every day is an incredible experience filled with serenity and beauty, as residents can stroll down the boardwalk, taking in the glistening lagoon on one side and the city skyline on the other, creating a truly magical experience.

The 350 Riverside Crescent is a masterpiece of luxury, nestled within a breathtaking development that spans eight million square feet, featuring serene waterfronts, tranquil lagoons, and a profound connection with nature. This remarkable enclave boasts open spaces and lush landscaping that invite residents into a world of natural splendor, redefining the concept of luxury living. Every detail of the tower, from its meticulously designed apartments to its lavish surroundings, exudes opulence and refinement, creating a world of absolute luxury and comfort.

340 Riverside Crescent is a spectacular tower nestled within Sobha Hartland II, encompassing a rich sense of community and superlative waterfront living in one of the city's most sought-after locations. This exquisite development offers elegant-styled abodes expertly crafted to create a sense of relaxed wellbeing amid lavish surrounds for everlasting luxury. With a collection of residences that mirror the soul, 340 Riverside Crescent is a depiction of true vibrancy, close to the pulsating heart of Dubai, offering a front-row seat to outstanding waterfront living.

MJL Elara by Meraas is a premium residential development designed around family living, with a strong focus on spaciousness, comfort, and privacy. The development offers a higher proportion of 2- and 3-bedroom residences, complemented by contemporary architecture and thoughtfully planned layouts that maximise views in all directions. Controlled access and direct entry to each building from the shared basement and main lobby provide residents with added convenience and security.

Samana Golf Views by Samana Developers is an epitome of sophistication, designed for those who seek the very exclusive in everyday living with its refined charm and unrivaled amenities. This exclusive property boasts stunning architectural features and spacious layouts that exude elegance through top-of-the-line finishes and exceptional attention to detail. Every aspect has been meticulously crafted to set a new standard for luxury living, where sophistication meets the greens and residents can elevate their lives to new heights of opulence.

The 320 Riverside Crescent is a breathtaking residential masterpiece that redefines the epitome of sublime living, boasting an impressive presence with its fifty-seven stories of elegance and sophistication. This captivating development harmoniously integrates the elements of water and people, creating a unique way of life that is infused with enchantment and fulfillment.

Shahrukhz Residences is a waterfront residential tower inspired by Shah Rukh Khan and built around the idea of living life king style. A sculpted façade with flowing curves and warm metallic accents rises above the sea, while every level is oriented towards open water and the city skyline. The collection spans studios and flexible studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, King's layouts with signature dressing areas, and a separate wing of Ocean Residences with larger suites set closer to the water.

The Canopies Sanctuary is a residential neighbourhood by Aldar, set among landscaped parklands and planned around architecture and nature sharing the same space. Mid-rise buildings with curved, arched balconies frame a landscaped podium, while sculptural canopy structures shade garden paths, seating areas and outdoor spaces meant for everyday use. The residences include studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and a study. Gardens form the centre of the community, with dedicated places to exercise, work and meet neighbours.
